notes.title: Development Update 0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Massive improvements in movement system
[list]
[*]Added lean into curve while gliding 
[*]Added glide fade in
[*]Changed the way Nimmi loses height over time while gliding 
[*]Changed Jump, Doublejump, Falldown and Glide animation (Timing and Polishing)
[*]Changed the way Nimmi reacts to movement input while in air. 
[*]Changed the way jumps are working to support smoother and longer but controllable jumps
[*]Fixed spammable glide button 
[*]Fixed wrong fall down animation playing (hiccup in ABP)[/list]
[*]Massive improvements in camera system
[list]
[*]Added Camera adjusts height after time
[*]Added Camera automatically stays behind the player when not moved manually 
[*]Added reset camera function [/list]
[*]Attack Improvements 
[list]
[*]Added attack-stamina and simple temporarily HUD 
[*]Added heavy attack for testing (hold attack button) 
[*]Changed attack system to use the animation blueprint rather than playing animations from Player-BP 
[*]Changed the way the attack can be spammed  [/list]
[*]Added glide booster gameplay mechanic (still work in progress)
[*]Updated the old Input system to use Unreals new Enhanced Input System
[*]Redone Menu and UI logic to support ne Enhanced Input System
[/list]
